originalityPolicy: Every pixel is placed by integer-coordinate Pillow primitives in build_action_objective_suite.py. No generated, traced, photographed, or external raster pixels are sampled, and no claim of hand-pixeling is made.

restrictions: Original fictional objects only; no real heraldry, crests, shrine gates, temple bells, devotional objects, or real sacred items.
No readable text or glyphs: ledgers, slips, records, and print blocks carry only abstract strokes and dots.
Non-gory states only: civilians are bound with rope, knocked down, or sitting; no blood or injury detail.
Sacred-looking or record objects are never framed as loot or trophies; completion states show preservation, release, or repair.
No pixels are sampled from generated concepts, photographs, or other games.
